about.description: ZeroLab specializes in motion capture, embodied intelligence teleoperation, and data acquisition. We deliver full-stack solutions including our self-developed low-cost, high-precision wireless motion capture SiP chips, modules, full-body inertial motion capture systems, teleoperation platforms, and the "Shadowing" bipedal robot high-dynamic imitation platform. We are building an ecosystem driven by motion capture and teleoperation technology, and constructing an embodied intelligence database centered on "real humans, real machines, real scenarios, real work" to advance embodied AI brain training for generalized environments.
about.title: About Us

items.description: Using inertial full-body motion capture devices to collect human motion data for training humanoid robots is a cutting-edge and highly efficient approach. Unlike traditional camera-based motion capture systems, inertial motion capture devices are not affected by ambient lighting or occlusion, making them ideal for data collection in diverse complex environments. By capturing large volumes of high-quality human motion data, it provides rich training samples for the motion control systems of humanoid robots.
items.title: Humanoid Robot Training

items.description: Film and television production is a traditional market for motion capture. Genres such as sci-fi, fantasy, wuxia, and animation rely heavily on VFX, which in turn depend on motion capture technology. With technological advancements, high-precision inertial and hybrid inertial-optical capture systems have emerged, significantly reducing costs while achieving accuracy comparable to optical systems.
items.title: Virtual Production

items.description: The sports sector can be divided into two markets: professional sports and amateur recreation. In fields such as golf, rowing, fencing, running, and soccer, precise motion capture enables athlete performance evaluation, technique improvement, and comparative analysis against competitors' data.
items.title: Sports

items.description: Motion capture technology enables VR users to experience true immersion and interactivity. Technological advances have also made large-scale multi-user VR interaction, real-field multiplayer VR games, and VR-based virtual instruction possible, forming the foundational technology of the metaverse.
items.title: Gaming & Entertainment

items.description: One major application of motion capture is virtual digital humans. Popular virtual idols and streamers such as A-Soul, Liuyexi, AYAYI, and CodeMiko all rely on motion-capture-driven virtual human technology. Virtual streaming has become the fastest-growing category on Bilibili's live platform.
items.title: Virtual Influencers

items.description: Data captured through motion capture technology can be widely applied in sports and rehabilitation training, providing users with scientifically precise motion guidance.
